important_scope: Reuse paragraph_style v005 units as linguistic hints only; D/R units in its source reflect quantitative writing tasks, not new qualitative research methods.

problem.writing_intent: Begin with a bounded real tension, situate existing explanations, state specific core question.

framework.writing_intent: Compare nearest explanations, make conceptual distinctions, derive dimensions and counterpredictions.

case.writing_intent: Identify cases and record types; distinguish reported interviewee statements from researcher inference.

dimension.writing_intent: Each analytic chapter links theorized dimension to located evidence, competing interpretations and scope.

conclusion.writing_intent: Answer only what the observed material establishes; delimit conceptual contribution and future test.

manuscript_rules: Use the actual researched object and relationship as subject; do not pad paragraphs with empty academic jargon.
Do not copy source paragraphs or use original style exercises as empirical evidence.
Author-year references and claim register must link to supplied sources; avoid ordinary-author name-led narrative.
Preserve original case IDs, unit boundaries, interviewee/journalist/researcher voices and source status.
Qualitative claims must not claim quantitative inference or rescue/transaction completion without outcome evidence.
Do not change core question, theory dimensions, frozen status or existing budget during stylistic editing.
formal_prerequisite: Both independent research gate receipts and passed G3 business snapshot needed; current sources needs_review, so exploratory use only.
